svg.title: Main wiring harness laid flat
svg.desc: The main loom of a road motorcycle laid out flat: taped trunk, branches to each component ending in multi-pin connectors, fuse box, relays, earth points and wire colour codes. Only the battery positive feed is in the accent colour.
svg.text: Front of machine (headlight end) on the left; branch lengths shortened
Tracer: B/W = black insulation with a white stripe. G = earth (green or black) on most machines.
